1.  This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No. 624/2022 dated 12.10.2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, 1860 registered at Police Station Dayal Pur, and the proceedings emanating therefrom on the basis of settlement.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the parties have been able to resolve their disputes and reduce the same into writing vide MOU-cum-Settlement Deed dated 10.01.2023.
3. According to the terms of settlement, petitioner no.1 is to tender to respondent no.2 a sum of Rs.1,30,000/- towards the total settlement amount and dowry articles.
